Recording rule: keep details in one route-specific report under `research-wiki/experiments/`; keep this tracker as concise current state only; keep `research-wiki/log.md` as a short chronological index. Do not paste long stdout, JSON, Pro/Gemini/DeepSeek answers, or duplicate route-report content here.

Pro/Rosetta record rule: every accepted Rosetta Pro gate or route discussion must record `rosetta_recall_id`, `returned_conversation_id`, `returned_message_id`, `previous_conversation_id` when following up, `same_thread_verified`, `continuable_followup_status`, `history_persistence_status`, complete context package path, and package SHA256. If same-thread continuity or web-history persistence is not proven, record `NOT_CONTINUABLE_FULL_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` and resend complete context in any new discussion.

## Research Contract

- Goal: improve THUMOS14 AdaTAD + ActionFormer adaptation to strict non-uniform random-fixed 50% inputs through model-side sparse-aware changes.
- Strict baseline contract for model-side runs: `768 -> 384`, `keep_ratio=0.5`, `random_fixed_subsample`, no validation/test GT or teacher leakage, no raw-prediction shortcut, no unrecorded post-hoc result selection.
- Every run must state changed surface: input sampling, Adapter, projection, neck, head, loss/assignment, post-processing, launcher/gate, or diagnostic-only tooling.
- Oracle/test-GT sampling is diagnostic-only and cannot be mixed with deployable model-side claims.
- CVPR deadline rule: from `2026-06-05` to `2026-06-20`, record daily progress in `research-wiki/experiments/CVPR_15DAY_MAIN_EXPERIMENT_TRACKER_20260605.md`; by Day 15 the Sparse route must either support a CVPR-level main story or be explicitly frozen.
